study_identification_part.si_4_title: A normative modelling approach reveals age-atypical cortical thickness in a subgroup of males with autism spectrum disorder

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study utilized both ABIDE I and ABIDE II datasets, which were pooled together for large-scale neuroimaging analysis of autism spectrum disorder. The combined dataset provided a total sample of N=870 per group (ASD and TD) after matching and quality control procedures.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "we utilized the ABIDE datasets (ABIDE I and II; 15)"

answer.ABIDE (I+II): normative model training (TD group) and clinical application (ASD group)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The typically-developing (TD) group from ABIDE I+II was used to build the normative model of age-related cortical thickness. The ASD group was then evaluated against these norms to compute individualized w-scores representing age-related CT atypicality. The study used male-only data for normative modelling due to known sex-differential effects and limited female sample sizes.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Normative modelling of age-related CT effects was done utilizing male-only data from the typically developing group (TD)... These statistical norms were then used to compute a w-score (analogous to a z-score) for every individual with autism and every brain region"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Bethlehem2020.pdf.md: Results / Age-related normative modelling, L31; L45-46

model-1.model-name: LOESS-based cortical thickness normative model (male only)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The initial matched sample consisted of N=870 TD individuals per group. After normative modelling selection (excluding age bins with fewer than 5 data-points and individuals without resting-state fMRI), the final TD sample for computing norms was N=624. The normative model was built using male TD participants only.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Overall-phase refers to the full matched TD male sample (N=660 from Table 2). Train-phase refers to the final TD sample after normative modelling selection (N=624 from Table 1), which excluded age bins with <5 datapoints. The age range of 5-40 years is emphasized in the abstract. Note: The study used male-only data for normative modelling.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: The normative model was built using male-only TD data. Females were excluded from normative modelling due to known sex-differential developmental trajectories and insufficient sample sizes in the female group for age-wise binning. The full TD sample contained 660 males and 210 females (Table 2), but only males were used for the normative model.
